title: Comparing Satisfaction With a Participatory Driven Web-application and a Standard Website
brief_summary: This project studies the effects of involving patients in the development of a web-application.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Contacting general practice with low back pain

Exclusion Criteria:

* Spinal stenosis
* Spine fractures
* Cauda equina syndrome
* Spinal malignancy
* Osteoporosis
* Spondyloarthritis
* Without Danish reading skills
* Without internet access
* Pregnant women
